meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 Istio、Linkerd 等服务网格搭建可观测性:配置分布式追踪与指标、排查延迟和错误、定义服务通信 SLO,并给出模板与配置示例。
howto.when: 当你需要搭建网格监控、排查延迟与错误问题,或为服务通信定义 SLO 时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude sets up observability for service meshes such as Istio and Linkerd: distributed tracing, mesh metrics, latency and error debugging, SLOs for service communication, plus templates and examples.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or defining SLOs for service communication.

say_en.text: Set up distributed tracing for my Istio mesh
My service-to-service P99 latency is over 500ms; help me debug
say_en.note: Uses golden signals to find bottlenecks

say_en.text: Define SLOs for service communication and add alerts
